content: In Colossians, Paul says to set your minds on things where?
explanation: Christ is seated at God's right hand. “Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.” (Colossians 3:2, BSB)

content: In Colossians, Paul says forgive as who forgave you?
explanation: Bear with one another. “Forgive as the Lord forgave you.” (Colossians 3:13, BSB)

content: In Colossians, what should you put on over all other virtues?
explanation: It binds everything in unity. “And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.” (Colossians 3:14, BSB)

content: In Colossians, what are children told to do in everything?
explanation: This pleases the Lord. “Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.” (Colossians 3:20, BSB)

content: In Colossians, for whom should you work at whatever you do?
explanation: Work with your whole being. “Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, for the Lord and not for men” (Colossians 3:23, BSB)

content: In Colossians, what should rule in your hearts?
explanation: And be thankful. “Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts” (Colossians 3:15, BSB)

content: In Colossians, believers rooted in Christ should overflow with what?
explanation: They are built up in Him. “and overflowing with thankfulness.” (Colossians 2:7, BSB)

content: In Colossians, all things were created through whom?
explanation: And for Him. “All things were created through Him and for Him.” (Colossians 1:16, BSB)

content: In Colossians, our speech should be gracious and seasoned with what?
explanation: So you can answer everyone. “Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt” (Colossians 4:6, BSB)

content: In Colossians, what was Luke's job?
explanation: Paul calls him beloved. “Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas send you greetings.” (Colossians 4:14, BSB)

content: In Colossians, the Son is the image of whom?
explanation: He is firstborn over creation. “The Son is the image of the invisible God” (Colossians 1:15, BSB)

content: In Colossians, what holds together in Christ?
explanation: He is before all things. “He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.” (Colossians 1:17, BSB)

content: In Colossians, since you received Christ Jesus as Lord, what should you do?
explanation: Stay rooted in Him. “Therefore, just as you have received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to walk in Him” (Colossians 2:6, BSB)

content: In Colossians, God's chosen people should clothe themselves with what?
explanation: Also humility, gentleness, and patience. “clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.” (Colossians 3:12, BSB)

content: In Colossians, what should richly dwell within you?
explanation: Teach and sing with gratitude. “Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you” (Colossians 3:16, BSB)

content: In Colossians, in whose name should you do everything in word or deed?
explanation: Give thanks to God through Him. “do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus” (Colossians 3:17, BSB)

content: In Colossians, where does Paul say Christ is seated?
explanation: So strive for things above. “where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.” (Colossians 3:1, BSB)

content: To the saints in which city did Paul write Colossians?
explanation: Timothy was with him. “To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae” (Colossians 1:2, BSB)

content: In Colossians, which church was also to read Paul's letter?
explanation: Letters were shared between churches. “make sure that it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans” (Colossians 4:16, BSB)

content: In Colossians, who was always wrestling in prayer for the believers?
explanation: He was one of them. “He is always wrestling in prayer for you” (Colossians 4:12, BSB)

content: In Colossians, who was sent with Tychicus as a faithful brother?
explanation: He was one of the Colossians. “With him I am sending Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you.” (Colossians 4:9, BSB)

content: In Colossians, who would tell the believers all the news about Paul?
explanation: He was a faithful minister. “Tychicus will tell you all the news about me.” (Colossians 4:7, BSB)
